presets.basic:
Minimal security headers for maximum compatibility.
✓ Best for: Testing, development, simple websites.
✓ Compatible with all applications and mobile apps.
presets.apiFriendly:
Optimized for mobile apps and API clients.
✓ Best for: Radarr, Sonarr, Plex, Jellyfin, Home Assistant, Vaultwarden.
✓ Strong transport security, allows cross-origin access.
Recommended for services accessed by mobile apps.
presets.strict:
Strong security for web applications.
✓ Best for: Web-only dashboards, admin panels.
⚠ May break mobile apps and API clients.
Not recommended for Radarr, Plex, or services with companion apps.
presets.paranoid:
Maximum security for high-risk applications.
✓ Best for: Banking, healthcare, compliance-critical apps.
⚠ WILL break mobile apps, API clients, and OAuth flows.
Only use if you understand and can customize every header.
